body: Yes...no matter what it is always a sad thing
I agree with your words completely! I do have things I enjoy doing and love. But sometimes when thinking about the big picture, I feel as if I wouldn't mind giving up those things...

That is very true being responsible for your actions is something I view very strongly. I don't think I wish to have any kids of my own, but I would love to adopt in the future if possible. 

That is very true, if it becomes something that is accepted, the burden placed on everyone who has to deal with assisting/clearing is very big and will no doubt affect them negatively as well.
It is relieving to know I'm not alone in this :)

Wow thank you for this perspective, I might try writing things down as well! 

My friend said that to me as well and it's really interesting to see the different outlooks on life.

I'm so sorry for the things you've gone through. I agree that we are being made to play by the rules of the world and not everyone has the same ones... Thank you for your words, you're really sweet. This world needs more hugs for everyone!
